args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 money amounts must be rounded with banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build test failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Changes
- Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (matches the function docstring and FIN-212 requirement).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix-round-half-even` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.

cc @alex for review.
